item.title: Teenage boy dies in tractor crash in Co. Clare
item.description: A teenage boy has died after a crash involving a tractor in County Clare. The 16-year-old was driving the tractor when the collision happened shortly before 2pm yesterday. Gardaí are appealing for witnesses. Emergency services were called to the scene on the R458 at Bunnahow, north of Crusheen in County Clare, shortly before 2 o'clock yesterday afternoon. item.title: Local residents urged to secure properties and stay vigilant this festive season
item.description: Shannonside residents are being urged to lock up and stay vigilant this festive season to prevent crime. An Garda Síochána's 'Lock up, Light up' campaign is now in full swing as part of Operation Thor. Statistics show that almost half of burglaries occur between 5pm and 11pm during the winter months. item.title: Documentary on former minister Mary O'Rourke to air on RTÉ tonight
item.description: A documentary highlighting the life of Mary O'Rourke is set to air on RTÉ tonight. It's part of the Cloch Le Carn series and starts at 7.30pm. The former TD and Government Minister passed away last year at the age of 87. One of Mary's sons Aengus is a councillor in Athlone. He says she had many different careers: Advertisement

item.title: Gardaí continue to investigate late night arson attacks in Longford Town
item.description: Gardaí are continuing to investigate a series of late night arson attacks across Longford Town. Five vehicles were burned at approximately 5am on Saturday morning outside five different houses in Ardnacassa Avenue, Palace Crescent, Ardeevan, Lisbrack Road and Canal Court. Longford Fire Service and Gardaí responded to the scene and no injuries have been reported. Gardaí are appealing to anyone with CCTV or dash cam footage of the incident to make contact with Longford Garda Station on 043 335 057

item.title: Planning application for long-awaited Carrick bypass to be lodged in 2026
item.description: A planning application for the long-awaited bypass of Carrick-on-Shannon will be lodged in 2026. It involves a 6-kilometre road around the town, from the Dublin Road to the Boyle Road. It will cost up to 500 million euro and aims to address big traffic problems in the town. Leitrim County Council chief executive, Joseph Gilhooly, says it's currently being designed: Advertisement
